about: The keys of a simplified policy's predicates object. access-control 6.1.6 takes predicates.mongodbPredicate as the mongodb predicate and ignores the top-level mongodbPredicate, sqlPredicate and querydslPredicate; the top-level rsqlPredicate still counts (r29fields-predicates-every-key, -nested-only), and predicates {} is refused (r29pap-policy-predicates-empty-bad). No golden sends another key inside predicates. Each policy has no condition, so check/resource allows; the filter says which keys became predicates of which dialect, and ALLOW means none did.

cases.about: Control: a DENY rule over a resource attribute that does not hold. True unless the stand answers every check with 400.
Only predicates.rsqlPredicate a==nested. The rsql text a==nested if a nested rsqlPredicate counts; ALLOW if not; a refused upload if the PAP counts mongodbPredicate alone as a format.
Only predicates.sqlPredicate a='nested'. The sql text if a nested sqlPredicate counts; ALLOW if not; a refused upload if the PAP counts mongodbPredicate alone as a format.
Only predicates.querydslPredicate. The querydsl text if a nested querydslPredicate counts; ALLOW if not; a refused upload if the PAP counts mongodbPredicate alone as a format.
rsqlPredicate, sqlPredicate, querydslPredicate and mongodbPredicate, all inside predicates. Each dialect's text says whether its nested key counts; the mongodb text is known to.

The top-level rsqlPredicate a==top beside predicates.rsqlPredicate a==nested. The rsql text says which one counts, or whether both do; a refused upload if the PAP counts mongodbPredicate alone as a format.

The top-level sqlPredicate and querydslPredicate, which 6.1.6 ignores, beside the nested ones. The sql and querydsl texts say whether the nested keys count when the top-level keys are there too; a refused upload if the PAP counts mongodbPredicate alone as a format.

predicates with one key that names no predicate format. ALLOW if the PAP takes any key; a refused upload if it needs a format key, as it refuses predicates {}, or if it refuses any key it does not know: r42open-predicates-nested-mongodb-and-unknown-key tells those two apart.

predicates with mongodbPredicate, which 6.1.6 takes, beside a key that names no format. USE_FILTER_CONDITION with the mongodb text if the PAP needs at least one format key; a refused upload if it refuses any key it does not know.
